1.21.1.4.0.27: Added core.load_default_plants to turn off AgriCraft's built-in plants and mutations for fully custom modpacks. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.26: Create harvesters now pass through crops on colliding crop sticks; added compat.create_harvester_reverts_growth to stop harvesters from setting back unripe crops. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.25: Fixed animals refusing AgriCraft seeds, seed bags deleting seeds, seed bag sorter switching, and /agricraft_seed disconnecting players. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.24: Added optional single-parent Mystical Agriculture cloning (disabled by default). Clippers now preserve growth on plants without clipping products and explain when a plant is immature. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.23: Fixed NeoForge seed composting, including the configured compost chance, disabling at zero, hopper insertion and data-pack reloads. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.22: Updated crop-stick artwork and collision shapes, eight revised crafting recipes, and contributor credit for 12lewisFTW. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.21: Updated sprinkler model and texture; fixed offhand clippers triggering ordinary harvesting. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.20: Starfield Pastoral 0.6.3fix1 compatibility, native crop genetics, irrigation, breeding and harvesting. See CHANGELOG.md.
1.21.1.4.0.19: Croptopia and The One Probe compatibility.
